item.title: [general] How AI Assistants are Moving the Security Goalposts
item.description: AI-based assistants or "agents" -- autonomous programs that have access to the user's computer, files, online services and can automate virtually any task -- are growing in popularity with developers and IT workers. But as so many eyebrow-raising headlines over the past few weeks have shown, these powerful and assertive new tools are rapidly shifting the security priorities for organizations, while blurring the lines between data and code, trusted co-worker and insider threat, ninja hacker and novice code jockey.

item.title: [general] Quantum threats are already active and the defense response remains fragmented
item.description: <p>Enterprises are moving toward post-quantum security at uneven speeds, and the gap between organizations that have built crypto-agility into their infrastructure and those that have adopted the label without the underlying capability is widening. Dr. Tan Teik Guan, CEO of Singapore-based cybersecurity company pQCee, draws a sharp line between the two. Crypto-agility, in his view, requires more than support for multiple algorithms or protocol-level negotiation. item.description: <p>Broadcom announced Symantec CBX (Carbon Black XDR), a cloud-based platform that combines Symantec and Carbon Black technologies in one intuitive solution. item.title: [general] Anvilogic’s Blueprints replaces SOAR complexity with natural language security automation
item.description: <p>Anvilogic has launched Blueprints, a workflow automation capability that captures expert analyst practices and turns them into scalable, repeatable workflows across security teams. Instead of requiring specialized engineers to build and maintain code, Blueprints lets analysts author automation in natural language, deploy it the same day, and have it execute to automate processes across data onboarding, detection engineering, threat hunting, investigation and response. &#8220;Your best analyst, at infinite scale,&#8221; said Mackenzie Kyle, Chief Product Officer &#8230; <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/03/23/anvilogic-blueprints/" rel="nofollow">More <span class="meta-nav">&#8594;</span></a></p> <p>The post <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/03/23/anvilogic-blueprints/">Anvilogic’s Blueprints replaces SOAR complexity with natural language security automation</a> appeared first on <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com">Help Net Security</a>.</p>

item.title: [general] Straiker enables visibility and runtime protection for enterprise AI agents
item.description: <p>Straiker has launched Discover AI and expanded Defend AI to secure coding agents, productivity agents, and custom-built agent platforms. That&#8217;s why Straiker built Discover AI and Defend AI: to give security teams visibility into what agents are running and protection against what they might do. item.title: [general] Rubrik SAGE enables semantic governance for enterprise AI agents at scale
